title: Introduce knowledge-base document, parser, chunking, retrieval, rerank, and vector-store boundaries
description: AstrBot KB work spans document metadata, media, parsers, chunkers, sparse/dense retrieval, rank fusion, embedding, rerank, and vector storage. Rust should define these ports before reintroducing RAG parity into core/runtime.

files.change: Define parser, chunker, document store, vector store, retrieval, rerank, and formatting ports.
Inject KB context through a request decoration boundary rather than direct provider/pipeline coupling.

criteria: Embedding/rerank providers remain provider capabilities, not KB storage implementations.
Document parsing and vector storage can be tested without runtime assembly.
Agent request decoration receives formatted KB context through a port.
